title: Official blog author records dry-run stage 16
summary: This iteration adds a dry-run mode to the final official-blog author-records command. It validates Stage 15 reviewed-authoring artifacts through the same draft-record path, reports planned record writes, keeps public output guards intact, and avoids creating curated record files or directories during dry-run validation.

lessons.lesson: The final curated-record write step needs a no-mutation validation mode.
lessons.evidence: Stage 16 adds `official-blog:author-records --dry-run`, which returns `drafts`, `records_planned`, and an empty `records_written` list without creating record directories.
lessons.recommended_action: Run dry-run before writing completed reviewed-authoring artifacts into `knowledge/official-blogs`.

lessons.lesson: Stage 15 reviewed-authoring artifacts should be treated as first-class final workflow inputs.
lessons.evidence: The dry-run regression feeds an `official_blog_reviewed_authoring` artifact directly into `official-blog:author-records`.
lessons.recommended_action: Use reviewed-authoring output as the handoff artifact for final author-record validation and writes.

suggestions.issue: The final official-blog author-record command could only be exercised by writing records, making it harder to safely verify completed reviewed-authoring artifacts.
suggestions.evidence: Stage 16 adds `--dry-run` support, path planning, no-write assertions, and public output guard coverage for dry-run planning directories.
suggestions.suggestion: Validate final official-blog authoring artifacts through `official-blog:author-records --dry-run` before performing the explicit write.
suggestions.expected_benefit: The official-blog knowledge workflow gains a deterministic no-mutation checkpoint between human-reviewed authoring and persistent graph updates.
suggestions.promotion_path: Implemented through CLI behavior and regression coverage.
validation_evidence: official-blog:author-records dry-run validates reviewed authoring without writing records

followups.action: Add an explicit operator runbook that sequences official-blog preview feed, intake, review packet, review decisions, authoring brief, reviewed authoring, dry-run author records, and final author-record write.
Add fixture-backed examples for a complete OpenAI and Anthropic official-blog ingestion run once the operator runbook exists.
